'''Trypto Buball''' was an [[Trypto Buball's species|alien]] [[Gender|male]] [[Farm|agricultural]] [[baron]] who grew wealthy due to the vast [[Space-fungus|space-fungi]] farming colonies that his family owned.<ref name="Topps" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VIII}} to [[34 ABY]].</ref> he was a guest<ref name="Sticker">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Ultimate Sticker Collection]]''</ref> at the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack]] in the [[city]] [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]] and was standing near a row of [[Lugjack|gaming machines]] when fellow patron [[Dobbu Scay]] mistook the [[BB-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[BB-8]] for one of the [[Slot machine|devices]].<ref name="TLJ" />

Buball was later standing in the [[casino]] crowds near BB-8's companions [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] when the pair spotted the [[gambler]] known as the [[Master Codebreaker]].<ref name="Novel">[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]]</ref> While at the casino, the baron wore a [[Color|black]] [[suit]] with a white trim along with black [[boot]]s, white [[Clothing|chaps]], and a white padded collar. He used a dark blue and silver [[cane]] to walk and had dark pink skin, yellow [[eye]]s, and a gray [[Hair|mustache]].<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trypto Buball first appeared in the [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ" /> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> Concept art of the character was created by [[Jake Lunt Davies]] and during production Buball was known as "Turkey Guy." The character was portrayed by [[Aidan Cook]]<ref name="Actor">{{Instagram|username=jakeluntdavies|url=p/B92lyFJjKx2|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2020-03-17|quote=Creature design from The Last Jedi. Internally nicknamed Turkey Guy and played by CFX stalwart Aiden Cook who I had previously incarcerated in the Bobbajo costume on TFA. As ever, thanks Aiden, you’re a star. #starwars #thelastjedi #conceptdesign #creaturedesign #alien #cfx|archivefile=File:JakeLuntDavies-TryptoBuball-Instagram.png|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/GzR42}}</ref> and unused B-roll footage of Buball shows him on other parts of the casino floor, including a close-up of the alien looking over the shoulder of a [[human]] casino guest.<ref name="Featurette">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga|scene=The Costumes and Creatures of Canto Bight}}</ref> The character was first identified in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released on the same day as the film.<ref name="Penguin">{{Penguin|url=books/558520/star-wars-the-last-jedi--the-visual-dictionary-by-pablo-hidalgo|text=Star Wars The Last Jedi The Visual Dictionary}}</ref>
